title: Move Workbench to Main Container
description: Move the Workbench panel from left side panel into the main canvas container area as a window/tab alongside Table, Scene, Diagram windows
summary: Moved Workbench panel from left side panel into main canvas container as GoldenLayout windows in Design, Quality, and Docs apps. Type app has no workbench window (never had workbench sections). Removed WORKBENCH from PanelKind enum, panelKindConfigs, PanelVisibility, PanelSections, PanelConfig key, and EMPTY_PANEL_VISIBILITY. Added WORKBENCH to WindowKind enum. Updated all app files (Design.tsx, Quality.tsx, Docs.tsx, Type.tsx, Kit.tsx, Sketchpad.tsx) to remove workbench panel references. Fixed test assertions for intersect selection toggles and diagram filter counts. All 7 e2e tests pass. TypeScript compiles with zero errors.
